youtube.title: Apollo 13's Oxygen Tank Was Damaged on Earth. Twice. Nobody Caught It.
youtube.description:
The oxygen tank that exploded on Apollo 13 was dropped about two inches at the factory in 1968. Its heater safety switches were never upgraded for the 65-volt launch-pad supply. During a pre-launch test the heater ran for hours, the switches welded shut, and the tank likely passed 1,000°F, damaging the wiring. On 13 April 1970, 200,000 miles from Earth, it exploded. The crew survived by using the lunar module as a lifeboat.

📂 Case File #048: The Apollo 13 Tank
